description: Updates an existing custom dashboard, allowing modifications to its title, widgets, and data filters; providing `widgets`, `projects`, `environment`, `period`, `start`, `end`, or `filters` will overwrite existing settings for those fields.

dashboard_id.description: The ID of the dashboard to be updated.
dashboard_id.title: Dashboard Id

end.description: The absolute end time for the dashboard's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-02T00:00:00Z'). If provided along with 'start', `period` is ignored. Replaces the existing end time.
end.title: End

environment.description: A list of environment names to filter the dashboard data by. Replaces the existing environment filter.
environment.title: Environment

filters.description: A dictionary of additional filters to apply to the dashboard data, replacing existing filters. Keys are filter names, values are filter values.
filters.title: Filters

id.description: Unique identifier for the dashboard; should match existing ID if updating.
id.title: Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

period.description: The relative time range period for the dashboard (e.g., '24h', '7d', '30d'). Replaces the existing period. If 'start' and 'end' are set, this is ignored.
period.title: Period

projects.description: A list of project IDs to filter the dashboard data by. Replaces the existing project filter.
projects.title: Projects

start.description: The absolute start time for the dashboard's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'). If provided along with 'end', `period` is ignored. Replaces the existing start time.
start.title: Start

title.description: The new title for the dashboard.
title.title: Title

utc.description: A boolean indicating whether the dashboard's time range should be displayed in UTC. `True` for UTC, `False` for the user's local time.
utc.title: Utc

widgets.description: A list of widget configurations to be updated or set for this dashboard. This will replace all existing widgets.

examples: Tracks P95 page load times over the last 7 days.
description.title: Description

id.description: The unique identifier for the widget.
id.title: Id

interval.description: The time interval for the widget's data aggregation, e.g., '5m', '1h', '1d'.
interval.title: Interval

layout.description: Request schema for widget layout defining position and size on the dashboard grid.

h.description: Height of the widget in grid units.
h.title: H

maxH.description: Maximum height of the widget in grid units.
maxH.title: Max H

maxW.description: Maximum width of the widget in grid units.
maxW.title: Max W

minH.description: Minimum height of the widget in grid units.
minH.title: Min H

minW.description: Minimum width of the widget in grid units.
minW.title: Min W

w.description: Width of the widget in grid units.
w.title: W

x.description: Horizontal position of the widget on the dashboard grid (0-indexed column).
x.title: X

y.description: Vertical position of the widget on the dashboard grid (0-indexed row).
y.title: Y

layout.title: WidgetLayoutRequest

limit.description: The maximum number of items to display in the widget. Required for 'top_n' display type and for chart widgets with group by (columns/aggregates). Also required for table widgets with sorting (orderby). Typical values: 5, 10, 20.
limit.title: Limit

queries.description: A list of query definitions associated with this widget.

aggregates.description: A list of aggregate functions to apply to the query. Valid functions for error-events: count(), count_unique(), eps(), epm(). Valid functions for spans: count(), avg(), p50(), p75(), p95(), p99(), sum(), failure_rate(), apdex(), count_unique(), user_misery().
aggregates.title: Aggregates

columns.description: A list of columns to display in the query results.
columns.title: Columns

conditions.description: Filter conditions for query results (e.g., 'event.type:error AND user.ip_address:127.0.0.1').
conditions.title: Conditions

fieldAliases.description: A list of aliases for the fields used in the query.
fieldAliases.title: Field Aliases

fields.description: A list of fields to be included in the query.
fields.title: Fields

id.description: The unique identifier for the query.
id.title: Id

isHidden.description: A boolean indicating whether the query is hidden in the UI.
isHidden.title: Is Hidden

onDemandExtractionDisabled.description: A boolean indicating whether on-demand extraction is explicitly disabled for the query.
onDemandExtractionDisabled.title: On Demand Extraction Disabled

onDemandExtractionEnabled.description: A boolean indicating whether on-demand extraction is enabled for the query.
onDemandExtractionEnabled.title: On Demand Extraction Enabled

onDemandExtractionExtractionState.description: The state of on-demand extraction for the query, indicating the current status of a requested data extraction.
onDemandExtractionExtractionState.title: On Demand Extraction Extraction State

orderby.description: Field or aggregate function to order query results by (prefix with '-' for descending). Must use a valid aggregate function for the chosen widget_type. For example, use '-count()' for error-events or '-p95(transaction.duration)' for spans.
orderby.title: Orderby

selectedAggregate.description: The index of the selected aggregate function from the 'aggregates' list.
selectedAggregate.title: Selected Aggregate

queries.title: Queries

thresholds.description: A dictionary defining thresholds for the widget, which can be used for conditional formatting or alerting.
thresholds.title: Thresholds

widgetType.description: Type of the widget. Use 'error-events' for error data, 'spans' for transaction/performance data (with 'is_transaction:true' filter in conditions for transaction-like behavior). Note: 'transaction-like' is deprecated.
widgetType.title: WidgetTypeEnm
